scope: All 39 native classical 3D realizations (five Platonic, thirteen Archimedean and thirteen Catalan identities with four additional mirror realizations, four Kepler-Poinsot); all sixteen classical regular 4D sources; selected convex A4/B4/F4 and Goursat H4 Wythoff representatives. No claim for all U75, Johnson, compounds, scaliforms, arbitrary imports or 2191 uniform 4D identities.

references.title: Heckman, Coxeter Groups, finite Coxeter group orders
references.basis: A3 24, B3 48, H3 120; A4 120, B4 384, F4 1152, H4 14400. Chiral snubs and their duals have the rotation group only. Polar duals preserve the group.

references.title: Schulte, Regular Polytopes, tables 18.1.1 and 18.2.1
references.basis: Six convex and ten Schlaefli-Hess regular 4D types; independent flag action crosscheck uses regular4d_validation.

references.title: Incidence controls
references.basis: Removing one icosahedral face leaves its setwise triangle stabilizer of order 6; adding one open five-face tesseract cell leaves order 8. Similarities preserve action permutations; a one-frame cube run cannot exhaust 48 actions.

policy: Recorded numerical evidence for literal supplied geometry; no exact algebraic certificate, baseline parity or classification promotion.
